items.description: Uploads a proposal package (budget form, project narrative, sponsor RFA) and returns an RA-friendly Markdown Budget Personnel & Compliance Requirements Analysis covering the personnel summary table, trainee summary with mentoring-plan flag, compliance requirement flags driven by budget content, senior-key-personnel document requirements matrix, subaward document requirements, budget overview table, and cost details. data.name: extract-personnel-identification
data.prompt:
You are extracting personnel from a proposal package (budget,
narrative, personnel forms). You receive the uploaded documents
AND any KB chunks.

Be 100% accurate. Quote names verbatim. Use null when a field
is absent — except for `undergraduates`, which MUST be an
integer (use 0 when no undergraduates appear in the budget).

## Salary and effort computation rules

Proposal budgets come in two common formats. You MUST handle
both:

(A) FTE / months-of-effort format (typical NSF, NIH):
    personnel are listed with their base salary, % effort or
    months of effort, and a derived salary_requested.
    - effort: "<N> months" or "<X>%" — quote verbatim from
      the budget.
    - salary_requested: dollar amount as printed
      ("$52,947" or "$52,947.00").

(B) Hours-times-hourly-rate format (used in numbered-
    section budget worksheets — HUD-424-CBW, DOI/BLM,
    USDA, and many federal cooperative-agreement
    programs with state/local/tribal recipients): personnel are
    listed with hours and an hourly rate.
    - effort: "<N> hours" — quote the hours figure verbatim.
    - salary_requested: COMPUTE as `hours * hourly_rate` and
      emit as a dollar string with thousands separators
      (e.g., 1332 * 39.75 -> "$52,947.00"). Do NOT leave
      null when hours and rate are both stated.

If the budget worksheet shows the derived Estimated Cost
column, prefer the budget's value over your computed value
(it already accounts for rounding).

## Subaward / subcontract classification

CRITICAL: Personnel who work for a DIFFERENT institution than
the prime applicant, AND whose costs flow through a
subcontract / subaward / consortium agreement, MUST be
classified as Co-PI or Sub-PI in `senior_key_personnel[]`
AND their full cost (salary + fringe + sub-indirect) MUST
be accounted for in the budget extraction task's
`subawards[]` array — NOT folded into the prime
institution's personnel total.

Signals that someone is a subaward Sub-PI rather than direct
personnel:
- Their salary line appears in numbered-section format Section 7
  ("Contracts and Sub-Grantees"), Section 6 ("Consultants"),
  or any section labeled Subcontract / Subaward / Consortium.
- The narrative explicitly says "subcontract with
  <institution>" or "subaward to <institution>" naming them.
- They are at a different institution than the lead PI AND
  their fringe rate / indirect rate differs from the prime's.

Their `role` is "Co-PI" when they are the technical lead of
the subaward, or "Sub-PI" / "Senior Personnel" when they are
a contributor.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- senior_key_personnel: JSON ARRAY of
  {name, role, institution, effort, salary_requested}
  objects. Include the prime PI AND any subaward Co-PIs /
  Sub-PIs (their institution is the SUBAWARDEE institution).
  role one of "PI", "Co-PI", "Sub-PI", "Senior Personnel",
  "Key Personnel". MUST contain at least one entry. When
  effort or salary cannot be derived from any pattern
  above, emit "Not specified in the document" (not null)
  for that field.
- postdocs: JSON ARRAY of {name, count} objects, or
  {name: null, count: N} when not individually named. Empty
  array when no postdocs are budgeted.
- graduate_research_assistants: JSON ARRAY of {name, count}
  objects, or {name: null, count: N} when not individually
  named. Empty array when none are budgeted.
- undergraduates: INTEGER count. Use 0 when no undergraduates
  appear in the budget. Never null.
- other_personnel: JSON ARRAY of {category, count} for any
  personnel not in the above buckets (e.g., research staff,
  administrative staff). Empty array when none.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: extract-budget-structure-and-triggers
data.prompt:
You are extracting budget structure and compliance triggers
from a proposal package. You receive the uploaded documents
AND any KB chunks.

Be 100% accurate. Preserve monetary amounts verbatim with
dollar signs and commas. Use null only when a field is
genuinely absent — see the zero-default rules below for
category totals.

## Budget format handling

Proposal budgets across federal agencies use several common
formats. Recognize all of them:

(A) SF-424 R&R Budget (Detailed) — used by NIH, NSF, DOE
    research, DOD research, EPA research, and most R&R-aligned
    research grants. Line-coded A through K:
      A. Senior/Key Personnel (with months-of-effort columns)
      B. Other Personnel
      D. Equipment ($5,000 threshold)
      E. Travel (domestic + foreign sub-lines)
      F. Participant/Trainee Support
      G. Other Direct Costs (G.1-G.9 subcategories including
         G.5 Subawards / Consortium / Contractual)
      H. Indirect Costs (F&A)
      I. Total Direct + Indirect
      K. Total Costs (cumulative)
    Personnel are listed with %effort or months-of-effort.
    Fringe appears on the same row as each person.

(B) SF-424A Budget Information (Non-Construction) — used for
    most non-research federal assistance. Lettered Section A-F
    summary with detail typically in a budget-narrative
    attachment.

(C) Numbered-section budget worksheets — used by HUD (the
    HUD-424-CBW variant), DOI/BLM, USDA, ED, EPA, HHS,
    DOE non-research, DOD non-research, and many federal
    cooperative-agreement programs. Common 10-section layout:
      Section 1 Personnel / Direct Labor
      Section 2 Fringe Benefits
      Section 3 Travel
      Section 4 Equipment ($5,000 threshold)
      Section 5 Supplies and Materials
      Section 6 Consultants
      Section 7 Contracts and Sub-Grantees (subawards)
      Section 8 Construction Costs (when applicable)
      Section 9 Other Direct Costs
      Section 10 Indirect Costs
    Final totals appear as "Subtotal of Direct Costs",
    "Total Indirect Costs", and "Total Estimated Costs
    (Subtotal Direct + Total Indirect)". Personnel may be
    hourly-rate (typical for cooperative agreements with
    state/local governments, tribal entities, and field-
    office programs) OR salary-based.

(D) Narrative-only budgets in PDF/docx where amounts are
    embedded in prose.

For numbered-section format specifically (format C: HUD-424-CBW, DOI, USDA, ED, EPA, HHS, DOE non-research, DOD non-research, and cooperative-agreement variants):
- Section 1 + Section 2 totals = total_personnel_cost (prime
  institution only). DO NOT include subaward salaries.
- Section 7 (Contracts and Sub-Grantees) =
  subaward_costs_total. Each unique institution under
  Section 7 is one entry in `subawards[]`. Aggregate all
  lines for one institution (salary, fringe, indirect)
  into that institution's amount.
- "Subtotal of Direct Costs" line -> total_direct_costs.
- "Total Indirect Costs" line -> total_indirect_costs.
- "Total Estimated Costs" line -> total_project_cost.
- Indirect rate appears on Section 10 line (e.g.,
  "0.475" -> "47.5% MTDC"). The base column shows the
  MTDC base.

## CRITICAL — explicit formulas for derived totals

These are the bugs that have surfaced repeatedly. Follow
each formula EXACTLY.

### total_personnel_cost FORMULA

  total_personnel_cost = SUM ONLY of compensation for
                         PRIME-institution personnel
                       = (Prime Direct Labor subtotal)
                       + (Prime Fringe Benefits subtotal)

CRITICAL — anti-double-count rules:

(a) DO NOT emit Direct Labor alone as
    total_personnel_cost. The "Total Direct Labor Cost"
    row in numbered-section format Section 1 is SALARIES ONLY —
    Fringe is on a separate Section 2 row. You must add
    both.

(b) EXCLUDE compensation for any person classified as
    Sub-PI / Co-PI at a SUBAWARDEE institution. Their
    salary, fringe, and sub-indirect are already captured
    in `subawards[]` / `subaward_costs_total`. Including
    them in total_personnel_cost would double-count.

    Equivalently: if a person appears in
    senior_key_personnel[] with institution = the
    subawardee institution, their salary_requested is
    EXCLUDED from total_personnel_cost.

(c) Self-check after computing: if any subaward person's
    salary_requested or their derived fringe is also
    represented inside your total_personnel_cost, you
    have double-counted. Subtract them out.

Worked example — CORRECT (prime is University of Idaho;
Stokan is at Towson via subaward):
- Prime salaries: Overton $52,947.00 + Ellison $34,057.44
                + Godfrey $17,100.16 = $104,104.60
- Prime fringe (25.9% on UI salaries): $26,963.09
- total_personnel_cost = $104,104.60 + $26,963.09
                       = $131,067.69 [CORRECT]

Worked example — WRONG (double-count of subaward person):
- All 4 salaries (UI + Stokan):
    $52,947.00 + $24,180.00 + $34,057.44 + $17,100.16
    = $128,284.60
- UI fringe: $26,963.09
- Stokan Towson fringe (8%): $1,934.40
- $128,284.60 + $26,963.09 + $1,934.40 = $157,182.09 [WRONG]
- This is wrong because Stokan's $24,180 + $1,934.40 are
  ALSO in subawards[0].amount of $38,257.60. Counting
  them in personnel inflates personnel by $26,114.40 and
  cascades through total_direct_costs,
  total_indirect_costs, and total_project_cost.

### subaward_costs_total FORMULA + $25K threshold disambiguation

  subaward_costs_total = SUM across each subawardee institution
                         of (subawardee salary + subawardee fringe
                          + subawardee indirect)

CRITICAL: A narrative phrase like "first $25,000 of our
subcontract with X" or "first $25K of the subaward"
describes the PRIME institution's MTDC base for ITS OWN
indirect calculation — that $25K is NOT a separate subaward
cost component, and the prime's indirect on that $25K is
NOT part of the subaward total. Both belong to the PRIME's
indirect.

Worked example (Towson University is the subawardee, UI is
prime; narrative says "Towson charges 46.5% on Stokan
salary + fringe, while UI charges 47.5% on... the first
$25,000 of our subcontract with Towson"):
- Stokan salary at Towson = $24,180.00
- Stokan fringe at Towson (8%) = $24,180.00 * 0.08 = $1,934.40
- Towson's own indirect (46.5% on $26,114.40 base) = $12,143.20
- subawards[0] amount = $24,180.00 + $1,934.40 + $12,143.20 = $38,257.60
- DO NOT add the $25,000 threshold as a subaward cost line.
- DO NOT add UI's 47.5% indirect on that $25K as a subaward
  cost — that flows into total_indirect_costs (prime's),
  not into subaward_costs_total.
- subaward_costs_total = $38,257.60 (sum across institutions
  if there were more than one)

If you produce a subaward total that exceeds (subawardee
salary + subawardee fringe + subawardee indirect), you have
a bug. Re-check.

### total_direct_costs FORMULA

  total_direct_costs = total_personnel_cost
                     + equipment_total
                     + travel_total
                     + participant_trainee_support_total
                     + other_direct_costs_total
                     + subaward_costs_total

PRIORITY ORDER:
1. If the budget has an explicit "Subtotal of Direct Costs",
   "Total Direct Costs", or "K. Total Direct Costs" line in
   the extracted text, USE THAT LINE VERBATIM.
2. Otherwise, COMPUTE using the formula above. Never emit
   null.

Worked example:
- $131,067.69 + $0 + $0 + $0 + $207.20 + $38,257.60 = $169,532.49

### total_indirect_costs FORMULA

  total_indirect_costs = prime_indirect_rate * prime_MTDC_base

For numbered-section formats and similar, the prime's MTDC base
typically EXCLUDES:
- Equipment
- Capital expenditures
- Participant support
- Subaward amounts BEYOND the first $25,000 per subaward
  (i.e., for a $38,257.60 subaward, only the first
  $25,000 is in the prime's MTDC base; the remaining
  $13,257.60 is excluded).

PRIORITY ORDER:
1. If the budget has an explicit "Total Indirect Costs" or
   "J. Indirect Costs" line in the extracted text, USE
   THAT LINE VERBATIM.
2. Otherwise COMPUTE using the formula above. Never emit
   null.

Worked example:
- Prime indirect rate = 47.5% MTDC
- Prime MTDC base = $131,067.69 personnel + $207.20 supplies
                  + $25,000.00 (first $25K of $38,257.60 subaward)
                = $156,274.89
- total_indirect_costs = 0.475 * $156,274.89 = $74,230.57

### total_project_cost FORMULA

  total_project_cost = total_direct_costs + total_indirect_costs

PRIORITY ORDER:
1. If the budget has an explicit "Total Estimated Costs",
   "Total Project Cost", or "Total Direct and Indirect
   Costs" line, USE THAT LINE VERBATIM (including cents).
2. Otherwise compute. Never emit null.

Worked example:
- $169,532.49 + $74,230.57 = $243,763.06

## Zero-default rules for category totals

A budget structure with NO line items in a category
genuinely has $0 in that category, not unknown. Use these
conventions:

- equipment_total: "$0" when Section 4 (numbered-section format) / line D (SF-424 R&R)
  has no items. null only when the budget is unreadable.
- travel_total: "$0" when Section 3 has no items.
- participant_trainee_support_total: "$0" when Section 8
  (NSF line F) has no items.
- other_direct_costs_total: "$0" when no other-direct line
  items exist.
- subaward_costs_total: "$0" when no subawards exist.

## Budget period detection

- "Single-year" when the budget shows ONE budget period or
  ONE year column. Numbered-section budget worksheets are typically single-period unless
  explicitly stated otherwise.
- "Multi-year (N periods)" ONLY when (a) the budget shows
  multiple year columns (Year 1, Year 2, ...) with separate
  totals OR (b) the narrative explicitly states the project
  duration is N years with annual budgets.
- Default to "Single-year" when ambiguous. Never hallucinate
  a multi-year structure on a single-period budget.

Emit a JSON object with these keys:

- budget_categories: JSON ARRAY of {category, amount}
  objects, one per top-level budget category (Personnel,
  Fringe, Equipment, Travel, Participant/Trainee Support,
  Other Direct Costs, Subaward Costs). amount is a dollar
  STRING ("$104,104.60") — never a number, never null. Use
  "$0" for zero categories.
- total_personnel_cost: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  Never null.
- equipment_total: STRING. "$0" when no equipment.
- travel_total: STRING. "$0" when no travel.
- participant_trainee_support_total: STRING. "$0" when none.
- other_direct_costs_total: STRING. "$0" when none.
- subaward_costs_total: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  "$0" when no subawards.
- total_direct_costs: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  Never null.
- total_indirect_costs: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  Never null.
- total_project_cost: STRING. Apply the formula above.
  Never null.
- fa_rate: STRING. F&A rate as percentage with base
  annotation (e.g., "47.5% MTDC"). When prime and subaward
  institutions have different rates, list both (e.g.,
  "47.5% MTDC (prime, University of Idaho); 46.5% (Towson
  University subaward)").
- cost_sharing: STRING. "None" when the budget shows no
  applicant match or other cost-share commitments.
  Otherwise a description of cost-share commitments.
- budget_periods: STRING. "Single-year" or "Multi-year (N
  periods)" per the detection rules above.
- subawards: JSON ARRAY of {institution, amount, sub_pi}
  objects, one per subaward institution. amount aggregates
  ALL lines for that institution (salary + fringe + sub-
  indirect) per the formula above. sub_pi is the named
  Co-PI / Sub-PI from that institution, or null when not
  identified. Empty array when no subawards exist.
- equipment_items: JSON ARRAY of {item, amount} for items
  >= $5,000. Empty array when none.
- foreign_travel_present: BOOLEAN. True only when the
  budget or narrative explicitly references travel outside
  the United States.
- has_postdocs_or_grad_students: BOOLEAN (derive from
  personnel extraction in your context — true when the
  personnel fragment's postdocs[] or
  graduate_research_assistants[] is non-empty with count
  > 0).
- has_subawards: BOOLEAN. True when subawards[] has at
  least one entry OR when numbered-section format Section 7 (Contracts and
  Sub-Grantees) / SF-424 R&R line G.5 Subawards / NIH consortium line has any non-zero subaward line
  items.
- has_equipment_over_5k: BOOLEAN. True when
  equipment_items[] has at least one entry.

## Output

Emit exactly one JSON object. No preamble, no markdown
fences.

data.name: proposal-budget-personnel-consolidation
data.prompt:
You are the consolidation step of the Proposal Budget
Personnel & Compliance Requirements workflow. You receive
TWO JSON object fragments from the previous step:

1. Personnel identification (senior_key_personnel, postdocs,
   graduate_research_assistants, undergraduates,
   other_personnel)
2. Budget structure and compliance triggers
   (budget_categories, total_personnel_cost, equipment_total,
   travel_total, participant_trainee_support_total,
   other_direct_costs_total, subaward_costs_total,
   total_direct_costs, total_indirect_costs,
   total_project_cost, fa_rate, cost_sharing, budget_periods,
   subawards, equipment_items, foreign_travel_present,
   has_postdocs_or_grad_students, has_subawards,
   has_equipment_over_5k)

Render a single RA-friendly Markdown Budget Personnel &
Compliance Requirements Analysis. The deliverable is Markdown
— NOT a JSON object and NOT a JSON code fence. The audience
is a research administrator who will copy this into Word,
paste into an email to the proposal team, or save to a
shared folder.

## CRITICAL — ALWAYS RENDER THE DELIVERABLE

You MUST render the FULL Markdown deliverable structure (every
section listed below), EVEN WHEN some fragment fields arrive
as null, empty, missing, or sparse. NEVER refuse to render
with apologetic prose like "The provided context does not
contain the required information." That output is unusable —
the operator needs the full structure with placeholders so
they can see which fields need to be chased.

Substitution rules when a field is null or missing:
- Required scalar fields: substitute the literal string
  "Not specified in the document".
- Optional table cells: substitute "—" (em dash).
- Budget category totals (equipment_total, travel_total,
  participant_trainee_support_total,
  other_direct_costs_total, subaward_costs_total):
  substitute "$0" — a budget with no line items in a
  category genuinely has $0 in that category.
- Empty arrays for personnel / subawards / equipment:
  render the section with its empty-state language already
  specified below.

If EVERY field across BOTH upstream fragments is null
(which means the document genuinely contained nothing
extractable OR the document was not attached to the run),
STILL render the full Markdown structure with "Not
specified in the document" placeholders throughout, AND
append a single line at the very end of the deliverable:

> ⚠️ The upstream extraction returned no data from the
> uploaded document. Verify the document was attached and
> re-run the workflow.

## Required structure (in this exact order)

# Proposal Budget Personnel & Compliance Requirements Analysis

### PERSONNEL SUMMARY

| # | Name | Role | Institution | Effort | Salary Requested |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|

One row per senior_key_personnel entry. This table is the
authoritative list of individuals who each require a full set
of senior key documents. Include subaward Co-PIs / Sub-PIs
in this list with their SUBAWARDEE institution.

---

### TRAINEE SUMMARY

- **Postdoctoral Researchers:** <total postdoc count> — <names or "not individually named">
- **Graduate Research Assistants:** <total grad-student count> — <names or "not individually named">
- **Undergraduate Students:** <undergraduates integer; render "0" when zero>
- **MENTORING PLAN REQUIRED:** ✅ Yes / ❌ No
  - Reason: <one-line explanation based on postdoc + grad-student counts; "no postdocs or graduate students in budget" when both counts are zero>

---

### COMPLIANCE REQUIREMENTS FLAGS

| Requirement | Triggered? | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Mentoring Plan | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <postdocs/grad students present or absent> |
| Subaward Commitment Forms | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <N subaward recipients identified; "0 subaward recipients identified" when has_subawards is false> |
| Equipment Justification | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <N equipment items over $5K present or absent> |
| Foreign Travel Justification | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <foreign travel present or absent> |
| Cost Sharing Documentation | ✅ Yes / ❌ No | <cost sharing present or absent> |

Use literal ✅ and ❌ glyphs (matches source convention).
Drive each flag from the corresponding BOOLEAN in the budget
fragment (has_postdocs_or_grad_students, has_subawards,
has_equipment_over_5k, foreign_travel_present, and
non-"None" cost_sharing).

---

### SENIOR KEY DOCUMENT REQUIREMENTS

| # | Name | Role | Institution | Biographical Sketch | Current & Pending Support | Collaborators & Affiliations | Synergistic Activities |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

One row per senior_key_personnel entry. Each document column
shows "☐ Required" (literal ☐ glyph + "Required").

Note: Each senior key person requires ALL four documents.
The checkboxes above are placeholders for the SPA to mark as
received during document completeness review.

---

### SUBAWARD DOCUMENT REQUIREMENTS

For each subaward recipient (if any), render a row in this
table:

| Subaward Recipient | Amount | Commitment Form | Budget | Budget Justification | Scope of Work | Sub-PI Senior Key Docs |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|

Each document column shows "☐ Required" placeholder.

If subawards is empty, state: "No subaward recipients
identified in the budget."

---

### BUDGET OVERVIEW

| Category | Amount |
|---|---|
| Total Personnel (Salary + Fringe) | <total_personnel_cost or "Not specified"> |
| Equipment | <equipment_total or "$0"> |
| Travel | <travel_total or "$0"> |
| Participant/Trainee Support | <participant_trainee_support_total or "$0"> |
| Other Direct Costs | <other_direct_costs_total or "$0"> |
| Subaward Costs | <subaward_costs_total or "$0"> |
| **Total Direct Costs** | **<total_direct_costs or "Not specified">** |
| Indirect Costs (F&A) | <total_indirect_costs or "Not specified"> |
| **Total Project Cost** | **<total_project_cost or "Not specified">** |

Note: Budget categories default to "$0" when the upstream
fragment didn't return a value, because a missing category
genuinely means $0 spend in that category. Only the
top-line totals (Total Personnel, Total Direct Costs,
Indirect Costs, Total Project Cost) get "Not specified" when
missing.

---

### COST DETAILS

- **F&A Rate:** <fa_rate or "Not specified">
- **Cost Sharing:** <cost_sharing or "Not specified">
- **Budget Periods:** <budget_periods or "Not specified">

---

## Placement contract (enforce as you render)

1. **Subaward Co-PIs / Sub-PIs appear in BOTH the PERSONNEL
   SUMMARY table (with their subawardee institution) AND in
   the SUBAWARD DOCUMENT REQUIREMENTS table.** Do not omit
   them from either. The personnel table is the senior-key
   document trigger; the subaward table is the
   subaward-package document trigger.
2. **Subaward institution costs appear ONLY in BUDGET
   OVERVIEW / Subaward Costs.** Do NOT also fold them into
   Total Personnel — that line is prime-institution only.
3. **Compliance flags derive ONLY from the BOOLEAN trigger
   fields in the budget fragment**
   (has_postdocs_or_grad_students, has_subawards,
   has_equipment_over_5k, foreign_travel_present,
   cost_sharing). Do not infer triggers from the document
   directly.
4. **Use ONLY the two JSON fragments above. Do NOT
   reference the original uploaded documents directly.** If
   a field is absent from the fragments, render the
   appropriate placeholder per the rules above — do not
   infer, fabricate, or pull from prior knowledge of the
   document text.

## Rendering rules

- Use literal ✅, ❌, and ☐ Unicode glyphs (do NOT substitute
  with [x] / [ ]).
- Bold every label and total in the BUDGET OVERVIEW table
  using `**...**`.
- Horizontal rules (---) between major sections.
- Preserve monetary amounts verbatim ($X,XXX.XX) — do not
  reformat or recompute.
- If any field arrives as a nested JSON object instead of
  a string, REWRITE into natural-language prose or a
  Markdown table before emitting — do NOT pass through
  {"key": "value"} syntax into the final Markdown.
- No JSON. No code fences around the output. No preamble.
  No closing commentary about the rendering. The output is
  the deliverable — render it as if you were writing the
  document directly.

validation_plan.name: Personnel count consistency
validation_plan.description: Verify the personnel count from Task 1 (Personnel Identification) aligns with the salary line items from Task 2 (Budget Structure).

validation_plan.name: Compliance trigger derivation
validation_plan.description: Verify mentoring_plan_required is true ONLY when postdocs or grad students are in the budget; verify has_subawards reflects actual subaward line items; verify has_equipment_over_5k reflects equipment line items over $5,000.

validation_plan.name: Budget totals reconciliation
validation_plan.description: Verify Total Direct Costs equals sum of all direct categories, and Total Project Cost equals Direct + Indirect.
